title: qory-stack.yaml
description: qory-stack.yaml: the ordered modules a harness is composed from, delivered to be extended; the checkout extending it defines what it is rendered for.

qory.description: The qory versions this document is written for: one or more comparators, such as >=0.3.0 <0.4.0; every one has to be satisfied.

bind.description: The entry that fills each role a document references, by kind and then by role: agents, commands or skills, each a map of a role to the name of one entry of that kind. A module writes ${qory:agents/coder}, and bind: {agents: {coder: rails-coder}} sets which agent that is.

extensions.description: Values qory copies into the report and does not read: keys of the author's choosing, each a value of any shape.

runtimes.description: The version qory run installs of each runtime, by the runtime's name, claude or codex: an exact version, such as 2.1.320. A runtime the stack leaves out installs its latest version. The harness section of a checkout's qory.yaml that extends the stack may pin a runtime too, and its pin wins.

version.description: An exact version: a digit, then up to 63 letters, digits, ., + or -. latest is not one.

workflows.description: The settings of each workflow the stack starts, by the workflow's name: a run that Qory Apiary dispatches starts the skill or command workflow-<name>, or else the one named <name>.

time_limit.description: How long a dispatched run of the workflow may run, counted from the run's open, as a duration: 7h or 45m. The time_limit_minutes in the run's documents, when they set it, applies instead. A workflow without it runs for at most 3 hours.

access.description: The access level the workflow declares for what a dispatched run of it works on: read, write-no-push, or write. Left out, it is read. A run takes the lower of this access and access in the run's documents, in the order read, write-no-push, write; documents with no target have no access, and this access applies alone. A dispatched run from a run code sees the checkout read-only when that level is read, and on Claude Code its settings deny Edit, Write and NotebookEdit; such a run with no wall, with wall.setup: inside, or whose image chosen at the run's open has nested Docker, whichever way it was selected, stops before the agent starts (docs/run.md, §Read workflows). A write-no-push run has a writable checkout, no push step, no submit, and no version of the artifact branch. At write the checkout is writable and qory pushes what the agent left.

tier.description: The tier that names the main session's model and effort for a dispatched run of the workflow: light, balanced, or thinking. Left out, the workflow names none. qory passes nothing new to the run: Qory Apiary resolves the model and effort from the tier.

plan.description: The artifact type whose launch version sets what the workflow's session may push: lowercase letters and digits in groups joined by single hyphens, 1 to 64 bytes. Left out, the workflow names none. Only a workflow with access write names one, and qory harness compose ends with an error for a type that no module of the stack declares a scope check for in scope_checks.

hook_points.description: The points of the workflow where a checkout extending the stack may add workflow hooks, by the point's name, unique across the workflows of the stack. A workflow hook is not a runtime hook, a module's hooks/<file>.

at.description: Where the point sits in the workflow's session: end, when its agent has exited and before its verdict counts; start, before its agent starts; inside, where the session's agent reaches it.

kinds.description: The kinds of hook the point takes.

extending.description: What a module of a checkout extending this stack may ship.

target.description: The targets the stack is written for: the runtimes and the models a checkout extending it may compose for. A resolved target outside either list fails the compose, and a stack that lists models makes the model required. Left out, every target is accepted.

hooks.description: Lets a checkout extending the stack add workflow hooks at the hook points of its workflows, within these limits. Left out, a checkout adds none.

per_point.description: The most hooks one point takes. Default: 3.

per_workflow.description: The most hooks the points of one workflow take together. Default: 10.

timeout.description: The longest a hook may run, and the timeout of a hook that sets none, as a duration in whole seconds, 1s or more: 10m. Default: 10 minutes.

bindRoles.description: The roles of one kind, each to the name of the one entry of that kind that fills the role.

bindAgentRoles.description: The agents roles, each to the name of the one agent that fills the role, or, for a group role, to the list of agents that fill it, which replaces the group's members.

oneOrMore.description: One name, or a list of them.

part.description: A merged part: true for all of it, or the names of some of it.

exclude.description: What of the module the compose leaves out; everything else is composed. Not with only.

only.description: The only things of the module the compose takes; everything not listed is left out. Not with exclude.

link.description: A name at the checkout root that links to the module's directory.

source.description: A directory; a git repository at a ref with the module's directory inside it; or a module the repository exports, selected by module, with path or git and ref defining the repository.

exportName.description: The name of an export, one path segment.
